answer: Rotating Challenge-Window Attestation. Each identity must answer a fresh, randomly generated challenge within a short window; answers alter a shared verification state, so a cloned answer fails because the expected response shifts with every prior submission. Duplicates propagate no valid ripple through the ledger. An attacker must solve each challenge independently, paying full compute and latency per identity, and a missed window forfeits accumulated timber. Spreading identities across shards raises coordination overhead past a single oasis of cheap throughput,
